purpose: Define a production visual brief that avoids both overproduction and a visible quality cliff from Valoria.

sameGameSignals: cool atmospheric base with sparse warm human traces
localized corruption rather than global purple wash
deliberateDifferencesFromCity: more negative space between strategic objects
POIs and marches read before micro-detail

densityBudget.rule: Use relief, forest masses, water/fog and natural barriers to make low-density space intentional rather than empty.

readability.far: cities, major terrain masses, corruption zone and primary routes remain obvious
readability.normal: resource nodes, threat, POI and march direction are immediately distinguishable
readability.near: supporting environment can reveal additional detail but cannot become required for recognition
readability.mobile: no dependence on tiny props, fine text or micro-contrast

failConditions: Valoria looks premium but World looks like greybox/prototype
toy-board or generic low-poly diorama read
roads look like artificial board-game strips
forest reads as repeated identical trees
UI labels are doing all recognition work
asset packs visibly clash with each other
world attempts city-level density everywhere and becomes noisy or too expensive
gateMeaning: WORLD/VALORIA CONTINUITY passes when the deliberate scale change feels like another layer of the same Eldoria game, not when the World reproduces Valoria's city-level density.
